hooks.command: s=scripts/ci/sibling-check-gate.mjs; d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; if [ -f "$d/$s" ]; then exec node "$d/$s"; fi; [ ! -f "$d/bin/site-hook" ] || exec sh "$d/bin/site-hook" "$s"

( ( s=scripts/prune-merged-worktrees.mjs; d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; if [ -f "$d/$s" ]; then exec node "$d/$s" --apply; fi; [ ! -f "$d/bin/site-hook" ] || exec sh "$d/bin/site-hook" "$s" --apply ) >/dev/null 2>&1 & ) || true
